method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Legal Profession Uniform Law (WA), legislation.wa.gov.au mrdoc 46913, retrieved 7 September 2026 (as-at date not shown), deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_46913.txt; Legal Profession Uniform General Rules 2015, mrdoc 45732, version 00-a0-02, currency from 1 July 2022, deposited in subject wa/legal-profession-uniform-general-rules-2015. The value of a penalty unit (Victorian) and the RBA Cash Rate Target are inputs.

checks.command: l4 run lpul-cases-costs.l4 ; l4 run lpul-cases-practice.l4 ; l4 run lpul-cases-trust.l4 ; l4 run lpul-qa.l4 ; l4 run lpul-qa-cases.l4 ; l4 check lpul-qa.l4
checks.result: 333 assertions satisfied (69 baseline + 264 Q&A layer), 0 errors, 0 warnings in all eight files; l4 check lpul-qa.l4: Check succeeded; parameter script: 60 questions, my role first in each, every shared parameter identical in type and @desc, each situation straight after the role, no DEONTIC or EVENT input (2026-11-06)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the lawyer's seat, what the Application Act baseline does not already encode: holding out (ss 6, 11, 12(3), (4)); certificate categories and conditions (ss 47, 48(2), 50, 51, 54, 86, 88, 150; General Rules r 15); trust money as it touches the client (ss 129, 134, 135, 137-145; General Rules rr 42, 52); legal costs other than costs agreements (ss 170, 172(4), 174, 177-179, 187, 188, 190, 191, 194, 195, 197, 198, 204, 207, Sch 4 cl 18(3), (4); General Rules rr 71, 72, 72A, 75). Admission, certificate grant and renewal, s 10, titles, supervised practice and costs agreements (ss 180-185) are in the Application Act baseline.

daniel d038 (2029-03-04): Acts for a client in an arbitration under a conditional costs agreement with a 25% uplift (disclosure, trust money, billing and assessment around it)
